content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have a minor request regarding the relevant clause before we proceed. - The current terms exclude certain obligations from the liability cap, which creates unnecessary financial exposure. I propose that we adjust this section so that the limitation of liability applies as follows: Limitation of liability as described in this article shall not apply in case the damage or loss is caused by a Party's willful misconduct or gross negligence. Please let me know if this adjustment is acceptable. Best regards,
